# Artlify

> Artlify is a full-service marketing agency for coaches and growing brands — social media management, content strategy and creation, copywriting, paid ads, campaigns, funnels and marketing automation, personalised to your brand.

## Services
- [Social Media Management](https://artlifyagency.com/services/social-media-management/): Planning, posting, engagement and reporting across the platforms your audience actually uses.
- [Content Strategy](https://artlifyagency.com/services/content-strategy/): Audience research, content pillars and a clear plan so every post works toward a goal.
- [Content Creation](https://artlifyagency.com/services/content-creation/): Reels, carousels, graphics and short-form video that look like you and speak to your audience.
- [Copywriting](https://artlifyagency.com/services/copywriting/): Website, sales page, email and ad copy written in your voice and built to convert.
- [Marketing Strategy](https://artlifyagency.com/services/marketing-strategy/): Positioning, offers, channels and a growth roadmap personalised to your business.
- [Campaigns & Launches](https://artlifyagency.com/services/campaigns/): Integrated launches and campaigns — concept, content, ads and email working together.
- [Paid Ads & Sponsored Ads](https://artlifyagency.com/services/paid-ads/): Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn and Google ads — strategy, creative, testing and clear reporting.
- [Influencer & Sponsorships](https://artlifyagency.com/services/influencer-sponsorships/): Creator sourcing, outreach, briefs and sponsorship management with the right partners.
- [Funnel Building](https://artlifyagency.com/services/funnel-building/): Landing pages, lead magnets, booking flows and checkouts designed to convert.
- [Marketing Automation](https://artlifyagency.com/services/marketing-automation/): Email sequences, CRM workflows and lead nurturing that save time and convert.

## Blog topics
- [Hiring an Agency](https://artlifyagency.com/blog/hiring-an-agency/): Everything you need to know before you hire a marketing agency: what it really costs, which questions to ask, the red flags to avoid, and when an agency is (and isn't) the right choice.
- [Social Media & Content](https://artlifyagency.com/blog/social-media/): Practical guides to social media and content that actually brings in clients and customers: strategy, content pillars, posting rhythm, captions, UGC and how to measure what's working.
- [Meta Ads & Paid Campaigns](https://artlifyagency.com/blog/meta-ads/): Step-by-step guides to Facebook and Instagram ads: how much to spend, how to target, which creative converts, what a good ROAS looks like, and how to fix ads that aren't working.
- [Funnels & Automation](https://artlifyagency.com/blog/funnels-automation/): How to turn attention into sales on autopilot: sales funnels, lead magnets, landing pages, email and WhatsApp flows, and the automation tools that tie them together.

## Articles
- [Agency vs Freelancer vs In-House Marketer: Which Should You Hire?](https://artlifyagency.com/blog/agency-vs-freelancer-vs-in-house-marketer/): Compare an agency, freelancer and in-house marketer by scope, management, costs and ownership to choose the right support for your business.
- [Best Marketing Agencies for Coaches in 2027](https://artlifyagency.com/blog/best-marketing-agency-for-coaches/): Compare seven marketing agencies for a coaching business. Review service fit, lead qualification, budgets and questions to ask before hiring.
- [How Much Should You Spend on Facebook and Instagram Ads?](https://artlifyagency.com/blog/facebook-instagram-ads-budget/): Plan your Facebook and Instagram ads budget around margins, customer costs and cash flow. Learn what to calculate before increasing spend.
- [How to Choose a Marketing Agency in 2027: The Complete Buyer's Guide](https://artlifyagency.com/blog/how-to-choose-a-marketing-agency/): Learn how to choose a marketing agency, compare proposals, check experience and ask the right questions before signing a contract.
- [How Much Does a Marketing Agency Cost in 2027?](https://artlifyagency.com/blog/marketing-agency-cost/): Compare agency fees, ad spend and scope. Understand Artlify's pricing range and what to check before committing to a marketing retainer.
- [Sales Funnels Explained: How to Build One That Converts in 2027](https://artlifyagency.com/blog/sales-funnel-guide/): Build a sales funnel around your offer, landing page, lead capture and follow-up. A practical guide for coaches and e-commerce businesses.
- [Social Media Marketing for Small Businesses: The 2027 Playbook](https://artlifyagency.com/blog/social-media-marketing-strategy-small-business/): Build a practical social media strategy with clear goals, useful content, a manageable calendar and reporting linked to your business.
- [Meta Ads for Beginners: What to Know Before Your First Campaign](https://artlifyagency.com/blog/meta-ads-for-beginners/): Understand Meta ads, prepare your offer, plan a budget and check your customer journey before launching a first campaign.
- [Social Media Strategy for Coaches: From Content to Qualified Enquiries](https://artlifyagency.com/blog/social-media-strategy-for-coaches/): Plan coaching content around your offer, audience questions and application process. Build a clear social strategy with useful reporting.
- [What Is a Marketing Funnel? A Plain-English Guide](https://artlifyagency.com/blog/what-is-a-marketing-funnel/): Understand marketing funnel stages, see coaching and e-commerce examples, and learn how to identify unclear steps in your customer journey.
